title: Set up a work session
story: You'll spend the afternoon testing GPU code. Start an interactive job with {{gpus}} GPUs, {{mem}} GB of memory and {{hours.0}} hours, load the cuda module inside it, check that you can see your GPUs, then leave the job.

tasks.text: Start the job with {{gpus}} GPUs, {{mem}} GB and {{hours.0}} hours
Load cuda and check your GPUs

hints: Time is `--time=HH:MM:SS`. `srun --gres=gpu:{{gpus}} --mem={{mem}}G --time={{hours.0}}:00:00 --pty bash`, then `module load cuda`, `nvidia-smi`, `exit`.
